hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that implements a configurable bonding curve instead of standard x*y=k. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes, takes input tokens from the pool manager, deposits them into Euler vaults, withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — bypassing standard LP liquidity entirely.
